sessions.title: A Strong statements: nouns and adjectives
sessions.description_vi: Các câu mạnh: danh từ và tính từ
sessions.value:
# Liking and disliking

## A Strong statements: nouns and adjectives

| noun | collocations |
| --- | --- |
| liking | I have a particular **liking** for quiet, relaxing music. She had a genuine **liking** for her cousins. |
| love | His great **love** of nature can be seen in his paintings. Her passionate **love** of the sea inspired her to sail round the world. |
| regard [formal] | I have always had the greatest **regard** for her. She has the highest **regard** for her teacher. |
| enjoyment | I will never forget the sheer **enjoyment** of listening to the children singing. We get great **enjoyment** out of our little cottage in the mountains. |
| pleasure | It’s been a great **pleasure** meeting you. I hope we meet again. It was such a huge **pleasure** to be able to relax and do nothing for a week. |
| preference | When asked, many people expressed a clear **preference** for organic food. I’ve always had a strong **preference** for short stories rather than novels. |
| dislike | I have an intense **dislike** of rock music that is played too loud. She took an instant **dislike** to Mr Peabody, but she did not know why. |
| aversion¹ | He has always had a huge **aversion** to hard work of any kind. Most people have a strong **aversion** to excessive violence on TV. |
| hatred | She had a deep **hatred** of politicians, especially corrupt ones. The deep-rooted **hatred** between the two families goes back several generations. |

¹ a feeling of strong dislike or a lack of willingness to do something

sessions.title: B Verbs and nouns
sessions.value:
# Liking and disliking

## B Verbs and nouns
These people are talking about their favourite airlines.

I think Globe Air are pretty good. You can **state your preference** for a special low fat menu, or seafood or vegetarian. They have great in-flight entertainment too – they try to **cater for tastes**. They seem to **take pride in** their service.

I do a lot of long-distance flying and I **don’t relish the thought**¹ of a twelve-hour flight with no leg-room, so I usually fly with Arrow. They give you a lot of space, even in economy. And they seem to **take pleasure** in looking after you.

I think most people **take offence**² if they’re just treated like a number. I **have no sympathy** for airlines that lose customers because they’re too lazy to **give a warm welcome** when they step on board. Visa Airlines are always very friendly.

¹ don't like to think that it is going to happen

² become upset because someone has insulted or disrespected them

sessions.title: C Other useful collocations for likes and dislikes
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ hữu ích khác cho sở thích và không thích
sessions.value:
# Liking and disliking

## C Other useful collocations for likes and dislikes
I like most James Bond Films, but Goldfinger is my absolute/all-time favourite.
I’ve always been a great lover of Mozart’s operas.
She’s a(n) ardent/dedicated fan of American football. [showing strong feelings]
I’m a keen admirer of the new President. He is such a strong leader.
My wife’s father always filled me with admiration. He achieved so much during his life.
It always gives me pleasure when I see my children doing well at school.

content_items.value:
I like most James Bond Films, but Goldfinger is my absolute/**all-time favourite**.
I’ve always been a **great lover of** Mozart’s operas.
She’s a(n) **ardent fan of**/ **dedicated fan of** American football. [showing strong feelings]

image.value: a person showing a liking for something

senses.definition_vi: Sự yêu thích, sự ưa chuộng.
examples: I have a particular liking for quiet, relaxing music.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để diễn tả một sự yêu thích cụ thể hoặc có tính cá nhân.

use_prompts.question: What kind of music do you enjoy most?
Is there any type of food you are especially fond of?
What kind of places do you most enjoy visiting on holiday?

dictation.text: I have a particular liking for quiet music.

paraphrase.source: I especially enjoy old black-and-white films.
paraphrase.model: I have a particular liking for old black-and-white films.

paraphrase.source: My father has always enjoyed spicy food.
paraphrase.model: My father has always had a liking for spicy food.

image.value: a person expressing love for nature

senses.definition_vi: Tình yêu, sự yêu mến sâu sắc.
examples: His great love of nature can be seen in his paintings.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một tình cảm mạnh mẽ và sâu sắc.

use_prompts.question: Why do some people choose to live in the countryside?
How can parents encourage children to enjoy reading?
What can we learn about artists from their paintings?

dictation.text: His great love of nature shows in his paintings.

paraphrase.source: He really enjoys nature, and you can see this in his paintings.
paraphrase.model: His great love of nature can be seen in his paintings.

paraphrase.source: She has always been very passionate about music.
paraphrase.model: She has always had a great love of music.

image.value: a person showing high regard for their teacher

senses.definition_vi: Sự kính trọng, sự quý mến (thường dùng trong văn phong trang trọng).
examples: I have always had the greatest regard for her.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mang tính trang trọng, thường dùng để diễn tả sự tôn trọng cao.

use_prompts.question: What kind of colleague or boss do you respect the most?
Which teacher from your school days do you admire most, and why?
Which family member do you look up to the most?

dictation.text: I have always had great regard for my teachers.

paraphrase.source: I have always respected and admired her very much.
paraphrase.model: I have always had the greatest regard for her.

paraphrase.source: Most staff think very highly of their manager.
paraphrase.model: Most staff have a high regard for their manager.

image.value: children singing with enjoyment

senses.definition_vi: Sự thích thú, sự hưởng thụ.
examples: I will never forget the sheer enjoyment of listening to the children singing.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả cảm giác vui vẻ, thích thú khi trải nghiệm điều gì đó.

use_prompts.question: Why do people keep reading novels when they could watch films instead?
Why do so many adults play amateur sports with no hope of winning prizes?
What do parents get from watching their children perform at school events?

dictation.text: She plays the piano for sheer enjoyment.

paraphrase.source: I will never forget how much I enjoyed listening to the children sing.
paraphrase.model: I will never forget the sheer enjoyment of listening to the children sing.

paraphrase.source: Many people read simply because they find it very pleasant.
paraphrase.model: Many people read purely for enjoyment.

image.value: a person relaxing with pleasure

senses.definition_vi: Sự hài lòng, sự vui thích, niềm vui.
examples: It’s been a great pleasure meeting you.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong các tình huống lịch sự hoặc để diễn tả niềm vui, sự hài lòng.

use_prompts.question: How do you feel when you meet someone important in your field?
What makes you happiest about spending time with your family?
What do you enjoy most about your favourite hobby?

dictation.text: It has been a great pleasure meeting you.

paraphrase.source: I really enjoyed meeting you.
paraphrase.model: It has been a great pleasure meeting you.

paraphrase.source: Gardening makes my grandmother very happy.
paraphrase.model: Gardening gives my grandmother great pleasure.

image.value: a person choosing between two options, showing preference

senses.definition_vi: Sự ưa thích hơn, sự ưu tiên.
examples: When asked, many people expressed a clear preference for organic food.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc chọn cái này hơn cái kia.

use_prompts.question: Do people in your country choose organic food over ordinary food?
Do young people prefer shopping online or in stores?
Do tourists in your country choose package holidays or independent travel?

dictation.text: Many people have a clear preference for organic food.

paraphrase.source: Most customers said they liked the cheaper model better.
paraphrase.model: Most customers expressed a clear preference for the cheaper model.

paraphrase.source: Young people tend to choose online shopping over going to stores.
paraphrase.model: Young people show a strong preference for online shopping.

image.value: a person showing dislike for loud rock music

senses.definition_vi: Sự không thích, sự ác cảm.
examples: I have an intense dislike of rock music that is played too loud.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả cảm giác không thích hoặc ác cảm.

use_prompts.question: Is there any kind of music you really cannot stand?
Is there any food that you hated as a child?
What tasks at work or school do people commonly hate doing?

dictation.text: I have an intense dislike of loud music.

paraphrase.source: I really hate rock music that is played too loud.
paraphrase.model: I have an intense dislike of rock music that is played too loud.

paraphrase.source: My brother has never enjoyed crowded places.
paraphrase.model: My brother has a strong dislike of crowded places.

image.value: a person showing aversion to hard work

senses.definition_vi: Sự ác cảm mạnh mẽ, sự ghê tởm.
examples: He has always had a huge aversion to hard work of any kind.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự không thích hoặc miễn cưỡng làm điều gì đó một cách mạnh mẽ.

use_prompts.question: Why are some people unwilling to do hard physical work?

paraphrase.model: He has always had a huge aversion to hard work of any kind.

image.value: a person showing deep hatred towards politicians

senses.definition_vi: Sự căm ghét, sự thù hận.
examples: She had a deep hatred of politicians, especially corrupt ones.

image.value: a person filling out a form to state their preference

image.value: a person looking offended

paraphrase.model: She took offence at his rude comment about her cooking.

image.value: a person showing no sympathy for someone
